result.topic_en: Draft of a letter (apparently to Weierstrass) thanking him for his reception in Berlin. It reports that the two results on the zeta function stated in Berlin (on the number of real roots of ξ(t)=0 between 0 and T, and on the convergence of the series of Li-terms) follow from a new expansion of ξ that is not yet simple enough to communicate. It closes with remarks on 2n-fold periodic functions of n variables.
